item.title: security: Lessons from 59 Linux Kernel Bug Reports
item.description:
Microsoft FORGE Lab researchers used codenamed MDASH to study Linux kernel vulnerabilities and reported 59 upstream bugs, with 33 CVEs assigned and 38 fixes merged. The post also notes eight local root privilege-escalation exploits and discusses the difficulty of validating AI-generated findings and getting fixes upstream.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: 3 lessons from frontier AI vulnerability research
item.description:
Microsoft Security says its FORGE Lab is applying frontier AI methods to scale vulnerability research beyond Windows, including work on the Linux kernel. The post highlights three takeaways from that research effort.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
